units.source_text: 古歌：“在此无常尘世中，多多莳种善因缘。

en.t: An old poem says: In this impermanent dusty world, sow many seeds of good karmic ties.
Where shall we meet again hereafter?
In Yasodhara's Garden of Blessed Ground.

units.source_text: 耶输多罗是释迦牟尼为太子时的妃子，后来与五百释女一同出家，

en.t: Yasodhara was Shakyamuni's consort when he was still a prince, and later she renounced the world together with five hundred women of the Shakya clan.

units.source_text: 为尼众之主，居福地园中。

en.t: She became the leader of the nuns and lived in the Garden of Blessed Ground.
